blurb: Lake George is known as the “Queen of American Lakes,” featuring 32 miles of water and 180 islands within the Adirondack Park. The region offers year-round adventures including cruises, charters, amusement parks, hiking, biking, skiing, and cultural experiences. Accommodation options range from luxury resorts and glamping to cabins and campgrounds.
